image_prompt_en: Landscape, high-detail photo-realistic scene: a modern stadium operations control room with a wide panoramic view onto a packed evening football pitch. Large wall screens display live AI dashboards with analytics panels labeled 'Player Performance', 'Attendance Forecast', 'Maintenance Alerts' and a prominent '82% AI Adoption' banner. Technicians and club staff wearing headsets and holding tablets monitor sensor feeds, player GPS overlays and ticketing heatmaps; visible sensors on players, drones above the pitch, and a side view of automated turnstiles. Moody stadium lighting, cinematic composition, realistic textures, 16:9 aspect ratio.
